about_the_game:
Bloodban: The Undeadseeker is a dark and acid sokoban game about hunting the undead and exploring obscure locations with a focus on replayability on each map.

CHASE DOWN THE UNDEAD!

Step into the boots of a feared and cunning undead hunter! (Which includes any kind of night creature, zombies, vampires, and other bizarre monstrosities.) Roam those shadowy lands and rid them of the tyranny of the cursed bloodsuckers! (Yes, we're talking about vampires.)



In Bloodban: The Undeadseeker, you’ll explore maps with unique themes, enemies, combinations, and layouts, all designed to challenge your strategy as you complete quests and push forward to new puzzles and regions.

DEFEAT YOUR FOES WITH POWER

Throughout the game, you'll encounter maps that require specific spells to clear. To acquire those spells, you'll need to choose your path wisely based on which abilities you feel are most useful to obtain first.

Insert image of quests

Each spell can be found in a specific map and must be equipped to unlock new areas or complete secondary quests in already explored locations.

Every new spell introduces a fresh mechanic and an exciting new way to act:

  • Repulsion: Magically pushes objects within the map.

  • Blood Sword: Summons a blade forged from blood, allowing you to attack enemies without taking damage.

  • Attraction: Magically pulls certain objects toward you.

  • Shadow: Conjures a moving shadow that travels in any direction—if it collides with an enemy, it inflicts damage.

  • Transformation: Morphs you into a bat, letting you traverse traps and cross gaps.

GOALS & QUESTS

Your goal as a hunter? Hunt. That’s all.

But in the game, you will also have the chance to discover new spells, encounter different enemies and uncover secret mysteries, dark secrets that are sinister and secretly enigmatic...

There are several mission types:

  • Wipe out every enemy in the map.

  • Collect all blood crystals.

  • Gather all the gold.

  • Unlock all doors.

  • Complete the map with the fewest possible steps and actions.

short_description: Find the Right Path! Explore castles and villages overrun by vampires! Exterminate the undead and… push boxes to solve puzzles! In this sokoban-style strategy game, you'll hunt zombies, vampires, and all kinds of monstrous abominations in search of powerful new spells.
